label: Человек
description: Twelve-mission case drill for человек (person, human) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form человек has a zero ending and names the subject. Here человек is the one who stands, so it remains in the nominative as the grammatical subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The nominative человек adds -а to become человека. The preposition без meaning without governs the genitive, marking человека as the one whose absence is felt.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. The ending shifts to -у, giving человеку. The verb помогать governs the dative, marking человеку as the recipient of the help.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of знать takes the accusative, but because человек is animate, the accusative copies the genitive: человека. Animacy is why the form ends in -а rather than staying человек.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The ending becomes -ом, producing человеком. The preposition с meaning together with requires the instrumental, naming человеком as the interlocutor.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The ending is -е, giving человеке. The preposition об meaning about forces the prepositional, the case for the topic of discussion.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural is suppletive: человек is replaced entirely by люди. As the ones who gathered, they stand in the nominative.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The suppletive stem люд- takes -ей, giving людей. The quantity word много governs the genitive plural, so the people counted appear as людей.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. The suppletive stem люд- takes the dative ending -ям, producing людям. The verb помогать governs the dative, marking людям as the recipients of the care.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The direct object of уважать would be accusative, but animacy makes the accusative plural copy the genitive plural: людей. The form matches the genitive, not a nominative-style ending, because the noun is animate.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The instrumental is irregular: the suppletive stem takes -ьми, giving людьми rather than the expected людями. The preposition с meaning with requires the instrumental, naming людьми as those worked alongside.

Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The suppletive stem люд- takes the prepositional ending -ях, giving людях. The preposition о meaning about governs the prepositional, marking людях as the topic of the book.
